svg.title: THE RIG wordmark
svg.desc: THE RIG wordmark v1 — "THE" in Steel, letter-spaced wide, regular weight; "RIG" in Navy, heavy black weight, tight kerning. The hierarchy carries the rigid+flow duality: THE breathes (the article, the wider spacing); RIG holds (the structure, the heavy mass). Authored 2026-04-26 in ops_cw.
